senses.definition: Interacting with or communicating with and reacting to each other; influencing or having an effect on each other; acting or capable of acting on each other or with the other.
(computer science) Offering or involving interaction with the user.
examples: an interactive digital map with zoom and pan features

senses.definition: A feature (as in a museum) that can be interacted with.

quotes.text: The show includes computer interactives, animation, models and live parakeets (for an exercise in species identification).
